limitations: Every selected workload has its own zero-action setup process and 1000-action process using the same fresh binary, fixed-width argument and equal-length probe environment values.
Fixed setup may differ across workloads and is never subtracted using another workload.
Instrumentation runs in four parallel lanes on distinct recorded CPUs. No Valgrind runtime is interpreted as latency.
Process exit skips destruction; frees are not a leak test. Allocation totals include all allocations performed inside the labeled action.
Prior shared-control attempts and timeout/interruption records remain unqualified for isolated action counts.
